name: Peach Cobbler Moon Rocks 5g
description: Warm, sweet, and dessert-inspired, Peach Cobbler Moon Rocks blend juicy peach flavor with smooth baked-good notes. The triple-layer combination of flower, concentrate, and kief creates an indulgent, high-powered experience.
